cases.case_label: Heterozygous Alu insertion in NF1 exon 37
cases.mechanism_detail: A heterozygous Alu inserted in NF1 exon 37 (patient A, previously identified, recovered by the TE-calling workflow) is stated to cause splicing defects and loss of functional protein by interrupting the exon; no new RNA data shown.
cases.quote: The exonic Alu elements lead to splicing defects and loss of functional protein by interrupting the normal exon (Fig 6B and 6D).

cases.case_label: Alu insertion in USH2A exon 45 in trans with c.5573-834A>G
cases.mechanism_detail: A heterozygous Alu in USH2A exon 45, in trans with the deep-intronic pathogenic c.5573-834A>G (patient B), is stated to cause splicing defects and loss of functional protein by interrupting the exon; no new RNA data shown.
cases.quote: In the case of USH2A, the Alu insertions was in trans with a known pathogenic splice variant (c.5573-834A>G), causing autosomal recessive Usher syndrome, type 2A (MIM 276901).
